title: Torvia Motors to launch Aera electric crossover from its Sanand plant in Q1 2027
body: Torvia Motors on Tuesday announced the Aera, a five-seat electric crossover that will roll out of its Sanand plant from Q1 2027. The company plans to build 60,000 units in the first year and will source tyres, battery packs and power electronics locally to meet the government's localisation norms. Bookings open in December across 140 dealerships, and the company said it is finalising suppliers for low rolling resistance EV tyres over the next quarter.
